exposure: All 2019-2024 and previously viewed platform outcomes are development-exposed
timing: Information F(t-1), position at close t, same-PERMNO raw return from close t to close next market date; expression lag is separate
endpoint_policy: Position date and next market return endpoint must lie within each summary interval; continuous history is computed once without annual window or holdings resets

local_wq.neutralization: SIC2 before rank and final target weights

numerical.policy: Near-zero cancellation residuals are zeroed before ranking relative to original group magnitude; final book constraints checked directly; infeasible days undefined

direction.fixed_source: Explicit original fixed_direction metadata only; generator reference-parent identity alone is not a signed direction
direction.otherwise: Choose once from 2019-2021 Local WQ train net mean under symmetric +/- target-weight costs
direction.tie_policy: Undefined direction if zero or within 64*machine_epsilon times mean absolute gross return
direction.application: One sign applied to both evaluation books and static platform expression; 2022-2024 never determines the sign

missing: Any missing nonzero-held same-security exact-next-market return makes strict daily P&L NA; weights never depend on future return visibility
statistics: Observable metrics are conditional summaries of finite strict daily returns. Complete-path NAV/MDD/Sharpe are reported only with no missing dates; initial NAV=1. Ratios are recomputed from daily records.

selection.strict_observability_denominator: Defined target-book dates with return endpoints in period; additionally report unconditional fraction over all period dates
quality: at least 2 of 3 development years have positive 5bps observable net mean
selection.ranking_input: Only full local checkpoint selection_metrics; platform exposure/identity extracted separately without Sharpe, Fitness or checks

diversity.weight_similarity: Daily cosine and absolute centered Pearson, pair counts retained
diversity.representatives: Fixed local order; compress when qualifying signal OR return redundancy threshold exceeds .80; unknown similarity never equals zero; no family quota

translation.review: First 300 local-qualified candidates in fixed order; continue in successive 100-candidate blocks if fewer than 20 eligible and local pool remains
